visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The woman with long black hair, dressed in a plain white t-shirt and dark trousers, is seen crouching in front of a minimalist white wardrobe. She excitedly pulls several orange Louis Vuitton boxes of various sizes towards herself, preparing to showcase her recent luxury haul to the viewers. (2) She picks up a small rectangular box and unfastens the blue ribbon. After opening it, she reveals a delicate silver necklace adorned with pearls and the signature LV logo. She puts it on and poses, while a comparison photo of a K-pop idol wearing a similar piece appears as a digital overlay. (3) Next, she opens a larger box to display a gold-toned necklace featuring the brand's logo and a floral motif. She layers it with the previous one, carefully adjusting it for the camera. Another reference image of the male idol is displayed in the corner to highlight the inspiration. (4) She proceeds to unbox a silk scarf with a beige and brown monogram pattern. She demonstrates how to style it as a headscarf, tying it securely. A high-fashion editorial photo of the same idol in a Vogue shoot wearing the scarf is overlaid to validate her purchase. (5) Switching to a humorous tone, she applies a face-distorting filter that enlarges her features while wearing the scarf. She makes funny expressions and gestures, adding a comedic break to the fashion review before returning to her normal appearance for the next item. (6) She introduces an LV monogram backpack with light tan leather straps. She demonstrates its versatility by wearing it as a traditional backpack and then adjusting the strap to show it as a crossbody bag. A photo of the idol carrying a larger version of the bag appears. (7) Finally, she shows a pair of white and grey sporty sneakers with visible LV branding. She holds them up close to the lens to show the texture and design details. She then stands up to show how they look with her trousers before concluding the video.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a catchy, medium-tempo electronic pop beat featuring synth melodies and a steady drum track. There is the distinct acoustic sound of cardboard boxes being slid across a floor and the soft rustle of packaging material, indicating the start of an unboxing sequence. (2) A female voice enters with high clarity and a friendly, casual tone. Her speech is moderately fast and expressive, reflecting excitement. The background music continues at a lower volume to ensure her narration remains the primary acoustic signal. Occasional paper rustles are heard as she handles items. (3) Short, bright 'pop' or 'ding' sound effects are strategically placed to synchronize with the appearance of graphic overlays on the screen. These sound effects have a high spectral brightness and act as auditory anchors for the viewer, marking the introduction of new comparison images. (4) During the filtered section, the vocal quality changes slightly to a more playful and exaggerated style. A cartoonish or comedy-style sound effect interrupts the flow to emphasize the humor. The BGM remains consistent in the background, maintaining the overall energetic vibe of the video. (5) In the final phase, the creator speaks with a conclusive cadence, her pitch rising slightly during the sign-off. The music swells slightly in volume as she says her farewells. The recording ends with a clean cut of both the speech and the background music track.
